answer: Proof of Stake protocols resist Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a delta between honest participation and the cost of capital acquisition. Similar to how a dense grove of trees requires time to cultivate, validator influence is rooted in assets. An attacker faces a ferrous barrier of economic penalty, as malicious behavior triggers slashing, effectively destroying the attacker’s staked value and rendering the creation of fake identities prohibitively expensive.
